==Biography==

===2017 Season===
In May of 2017, iBoy joined [[EDward Gaming]] as a young up and coming ADC. Although he wasn't the starter for EDG throughout the first half of the [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Season|2017 LPL Summer Split]], he played in the latter half. EDG finished 1st in the regular season and eventually won the [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Playoffs|2017 LPL Summer Playoffs]] after taking down RNG in the finals 3-2 in a reverse sweep.
EDG's [[2017 Season World Championship]] run was largely unsuccessful. The team finished tied for 3rd in their group along with [[ahq e-Sports Club]] and failed to advance to the Quarterfinals. Despite their failure, iBoy was able to showcase his innate talent as an ADC player.

== Trivia ==
* He, [[JackeyLove]] and [[Able]] were called the three genius ADCs of LPL.
* He likes to drink liquor and to play cards.
* Is nicknamed "Fishman" by Chinese fans, and "Banana Boy" by [[Meiko]] due to his love of the fruit.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on August 7, 2020.
** The 23rd player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on July 16, 2022.
** The 16th player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
